institution_name: Colegio de Estudios Superiores de Administración

coverage.notes: CESA officially advertises one undergraduate first degree, Administración de Empresas (nine semesters, Bogotá), with eight internal emphases; postgraduate programmes, exchanges and stand-alone English courses are out of scope. The IBO university statement lists English and Spanish among languages of degree programmes institution-wide, but CESA has not been found to state that this particular first degree can be completed wholly in English or give a first-year English-medium route for 2027-1. Programme p01 is therefore an investigated candidate rather than a verified in-scope English-taught degree. No separate degree-specific language catalogue/filter was found. The published 2027-1 admissions opening is July 2026; closing date displayed on inspected CESA page differs from more recently indexed CESA results. Fees published on inspected pages are 2026 references.

institution.summary: Private Bogotá higher-education institution founded in 1974; one on-campus undergraduate Business Administration degree.

programmes.name: Administración de Empresas
programmes.credential: Administrador de Empresas (undergraduate professional first degree)
programmes.about: A nine-semester undergraduate Business Administration degree in Bogotá combining core management, entrepreneurship and applied business learning with a choice of business emphases.
programmes.overview: Students examine how organisations are managed and how business decisions are made, with attention to entrepreneurship, ethics and international contexts. They can choose emphases including data analytics, marketing and sales, project consulting, fintech, sustainability, entrepreneurship, fashion management and international business. CESA describes small-class, personalised teaching involving business professionals, alongside opportunities for company placements, exchanges and international study. The degree awards the professional title Administrador de Empresas.
